args.summary: Overnight de-risk review for the 2026-10-09 open. The live tape is an ELEVATED, tech-led risk-off (NQ -1.06%, KOSPI -2.62%, 6/7 intl down avg -0.75%, VIX +2.2%, 10Y yield -0.87% and gold +1.37% = flight to safety) with energy the insulated winner (WTI +2.95%). The book stays defensive: HOLD the confirmed energy ballast (XOM) and the confirmed mega-cap quality name (MSFT, no fresh add into a selling open), and TRIM the two names whose risk/reward deteriorated overnight — MU (its hold thesis was explicitly conditioned on semis being insulated; KOSPI -2.62% and NQ -1.06% now falsify that, and its gate is hard-vetoed) and AAPL (distribution/late-stage, tech is the weak corner, take partial gains). No fresh adds into an open that has not stabilized; I revisit deployment once the tape steadies or a Prophet candidate triggers.

holdings.rationale: XOM is the book's strongest-confirmed name and tonight's insulated corner. Add-gate confluence +1.00 (size_authority 'hold' — maintain, don't add), bull lenses across growth/sector-RS/ETF-flows/options/rate-inflation, XLE is the #1 RS sector, and Prophet reads hold (triggered_pre_t1). In a tech-led risk-off with oil bid, a ~15% energy weight is exactly the ballast I want.
holdings.why_now: WTI crude is +2.95% overnight (vs +0.13% last night) while Nasdaq futures sell off -1.06%; energy is the winning corner and XOM is working as designed.
holdings.falsifier: WTI reverses below ~$85 and XLE loses its #1 sector RS, or XOM breaks its Prophet invalidation at 131.13.
evidence: overnight_tape: WTI crude +2.95%, equities tech-led risk-off
holdings.exit_plan: Trim/exit on a close below the 131.13 Prophet invalidation or if WTI rolls back under ~$85 and XLE loses top-sector RS.

holdings.rationale: MSFT is the only name in the universe with real add authority (gate PASSES, size_authority 'up', confluence +0.75, no hard veto), bull lenses across quality/growth/trend/sector-RS/options/alt-data, sits in XLK (leading RS, FRESH BUY), and the validated cycles plane reads risk_on (Charter P1 satisfied by ≥3 planes). But I keep it at HOLD, not ADD: I will not add fresh risk into an open that is actively selling and has not stabilized.
holdings.why_now: Nasdaq futures are -1.06% overnight — tech is tonight's weak corner — so this is not the moment to add even a gate-passing name; the confirmed position stays, fresh risk does not.
holdings.falsifier: MSFT closes below its 341.6 Prophet invalidation, or the engine gate flips to blocked / size_authority 'down'.

holdings.exit_plan: Hold while gate stays green and above 341.6; revisit an add only once the tape stabilizes (futures flat/green, VIX settling).

holdings.rationale: MU's overnight hold thesis was explicitly conditioned on semis NOT being in the weak corner. That condition is now falsified: KOSPI -2.62% (Korea semis) and NQ -1.06% put semis squarely in tonight's weak corner. On top of that the engine gate is BLOCKED by a hard veto (cycle_blocked) with a 'political_crowd_trap' divergence on an already-EXTENDED name, no Prophet plan, and the blow-off-unwind caution (bubble_ext 77%) is live. It is the book's largest single-name risk and underwater on the live print. I trim standard — not deep — because the name's own lenses are still bullish (trend/sector-RS/growth/valuation/options/alt-data) and SMH is the #1 FRESH-BUY basket, and it is only a 2-day position (anti-churn).
holdings.why_now: The specific tell that justified holding full size (semis insulated) inverted overnight — KOSPI -2.62%, NQ -1.06% — so I reduce the largest extended, gate-blocked single-name exposure into an elevated selloff.
holdings.falsifier: Semis stabilize (KOSPI/SMH recover, NQ back to flat/green) and MU's gate clears the cycle_blocked veto — then the trim was unnecessary and I would re-add.
